articles.title: Over 130 car parking spaces to become e-bike bays in attempt tackle bikes being abandoned on pavements
articles.summary: Lambeth Council, a south London authority, has signed a multi-million-pound deal with three e-bike operators. This agreement will convert over 130 kerbside car parking spaces into dedicated bike bays. It signifies a focus on sustainable urban mobility and promoting eco-friendly transport alternatives, aligning with global efforts to reduce reliance on conventional vehicles.

articles.title: Iranian and Romanian charged after trying to enter UK's nuclear submarine base
articles.summary: An Iranian man and a Romanian woman have been charged after attempting to enter a highly sensitive naval base in Scotland. This facility is home to Britain's nuclear-armed submarines, raising significant national security concerns. The incident highlights the critical importance of robust perimeter security and continuous vigilance around strategic defence installations, especially involving foreign nationals, for SSB aspirants to note regarding national safety and intelligence.

articles.title: Navy set to commission frontline stealth frigate 'Taragiri' on Apr 3
articles.summary: The indigenous stealth frigate 'Taragiri', equipped with advanced weapon systems and supersonic missiles, will be commissioned into the Indian Navy on April 3. This significant induction enhances India's naval power and reinforces its self-reliance in defence manufacturing. Taragiri's stealth capabilities make it a crucial asset for national security, demonstrating India's growing naval prowess.

articles.title: Indian army’s Fulcrum Brigade showcases combat readiness in Rajasthan desert drills at Bikaner Mahajan range
articles.summary: The Indian Army's Fulcrum Brigade recently showcased its robust combat readiness during extensive desert drills in Rajasthan. Conducted at the Bikaner Mahajan range, these exercises highlighted the brigade's operational capabilities and preparedness for challenging terrain. Such rigorous training ensures our forces remain battle-ready, enhancing national security and demonstrating strategic strength.

articles.title: MSMEs and start-ups are safeguarding national interests by strengthening defence capabilities & contributing to self-reliance vision: Raksha Rajya Mantri at National Defence Industries Conclave 2026
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence organized India's National Defence Industries Conclave (NDIC) 2026 to boost indigenous production and self-reliance, supporting 'Atmanirbhar Bharat'. For SSB aspirants, this event signifies India's commitment to modernizing its armed forces through domestic manufacturing, fostering innovation and strategic partnerships essential for national security and defence preparedness.

articles.title: United Kingdom - Submarine Combat and Weapon Systems, Technical Support, U.S. and UK Embedded Personnel, and Associated Training
articles.summary: The US Department of State's Bureau of Political-Military Affairs issued a Congressional notification on March 20, 2026, regarding a Foreign Military Sales request. The United Kingdom (UK) government has sought to purchase technical equipment from the US. This highlights continued defence procurement and strategic cooperation between these key NATO allies.

articles.title: Iranian Navy guides Indian tanker through Strait of Hormuz, crew member says
articles.summary: The Iranian Navy recently guided an Indian liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) tanker through the critical Strait of Hormuz, ensuring its safe passage on a pre-approved route. This action followed successful diplomatic engagement by New Delhi, highlighting India's proactive foreign policy and the importance of secure maritime trade routes for energy supply. Such incidents underscore regional maritime cooperation and India's efforts to protect its economic interests.
